notes.title: 《羔羊崛起：觉醒》重制进度更新！
notes.notes:
[p]Given that the freely customizable follower team-up gameplay in the early testing phase of [i]Rise of the Lambs[/i] was widely recognized by players, while the game had shortcomings in artistic quality, we have remade the art resources. Meanwhile, based on feedback from players during the early testing, we have further enriched and significantly upgraded the gameplay and experience![/p][p]
[/p][p]The main changes are as follows:[/p][p]
[/p][olist][*][p]Remade character models, animations, and special effects, greatly enhancing the sense of combat impact.[/p][/*][*][p]Optimized the AI mechanism for team followers, giving followers a certain degree of initiative![/p][/*][*][p]Remade the Sheep Village scenes, adding day, night, and different weather changes to create a full sense of atmosphere![/p][/*][*][p]Remade combat scenes, as well as monster designs and skill mechanisms. From battles in the beautiful outskirts of Sheep Village to the Lovecraftian doomsday setting of the Abyss Lair, each level offers a unique experience.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a time dimension; unleashing certain ultimate skills allows you to control time, triggering wonderful moments![/p][/*][*][p]Added superheroes, such as Black Mamba, Bruce Lee, and a mysterious hero, all with novel and interesting skill mechanisms![/p][/*][*][p]Added the "Fengshen List" system – send your favorite heroes to the Fengshen List![/p][/*][*][p]There are more exciting contents waiting for you to explore in battles![/p][/*][/olist][p]
[/p][p]Join the group to get the October test qualification: QQ Group 215623028[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45200395/8b7cc818aacb7ab50208cd6745bf93526b7a3c2d.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45200395/09565d0e152163cbd4db83f3219faf7c33451fee.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45200395/e571e03ccd177ca60e99e8dd22d28d9bc981e241.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45200395/713ae7fcdc81a1e81ede2601e3026aff99997865.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45200395/da08263ca801259b347eae305456289fe4dc4221.png"][/img][/p]
